cast: Lily (girl, 9) and her puppy Max. Colour pictures group several familiar things of one colour, so the child learns the colour, not one object.

words.scene: A few things that are all black, grouped together: a black cat, a black umbrella and a black top hat.
A few things that are all blue, grouped together: a blue umbrella, a blue toy boat, a small blue bird and a bowl of blueberries.
A few things that are all brown, grouped together: a brown teddy bear, a brown acorn, a brown wooden chair and a brown leather football.
Lily in her bedroom at night with the lights off, the room very dark, she looks out of the window at the dark night sky with stars and a thin moon.
more: It gets dark at six o'clock.
Lily has a dark blue coat.
Lily 有一件深蓝色的外套。

words.en: The king has a golden chair.
words.sz: 国王有一把金色的椅子。
words.scene: One shiny golden crown with little jewels, gleaming and sparkling.
more: The sun is golden in the evening.

words.scene: A few things that are all green, grouped together: a green leaf, a green apple, a green toy car and a small green frog.
A few things that are all grey, grouped together: a little grey mouse, a grey rain cloud, a round grey stone and a grey toy elephant.
more: The sky is grey. It's going to rain.
天空是灰色的，要下雨了。

words.en: It's dark. Turn on the light, please.
words.scene: Lily switching on a lamp in her room in the evening, warm bright light glowing from the lamp and filling the room.
more: Can you turn on the light, please?
senses: Lily has a light blue dress.

words.en: Lily has a light blue dress.
words.sz: Lily 有一条浅蓝色的裙子。
words.scene: Two T-shirts hanging side by side on a washing line: on the left a very light, pale sky-blue T-shirt glowing in the sun, on the right a very dark navy-blue T-shirt, so the light colour and the dark colour are easy to compare.
more: The kitchen is big and light.

words.sz: 我最喜欢的颜色是橙色。
more: Lily eats an orange after lunch.
Lily 午饭后吃了一个橙子。

words.en: Lily is ill. Her face is pale.
words.scene: Lily lying ill in bed with a very pale whitish face and tired eyes, a thermometer on the bedside table, Max looking up at her worried.
A few things that are all pink, grouped together: a pink piglet, a pink flower, a pink cupcake and a pink ribbon bow.
more: Lily 的书包是粉红色的。
Lily 戴着一顶粉红色的帽子。

words.sz: Lily 画了一朵紫色的花。
words.scene: A few things that are all purple, grouped together: a purple balloon, a bunch of purple grapes, a purple flower and a purple crayon.
A few things that are all bright red, grouped together: a red balloon, a red toy fire engine, a red strawberry and a red ladybird.
more: Lily 有一辆红色的自行车。

words.scene: A few shiny metallic silver things grouped together and gleaming: a silver ring, a little silver bell and a silver spoon.
more: 爸爸有一块银色的手表。

words.scene: A few things that are all white, grouped together on a soft pale blue background: a white snowman, a fluffy white cloud and a white lamb.
A few things that are all yellow, grouped together: a yellow rubber duck, a yellow banana, a yellow sunflower and a yellow star.
